>if muliple strikes are played can i use my skin of steel to prevent all
>damage (including earlier strikes) if so tell me how and where in the
>rules it explains this

You cannot prevent damage from prior strikes - only current and future strikes
this round.

From: aa...@cats.ucsc.edu (Thomas R Wylie)
Newsgroups: rec.games.trading-cards.jyhad
Subject: Revised Jyhad FAQ: 4/18/95 version
Date: 18 Apr 1995 23:01:44 GMT

Q: Can Skin of Steel prevent previous damage in a round?
A: No, it can only prevent current and future damage.
